reason: The riscv64 CI fails solely due to a conda solver error: "No candidates were found for libiconv 1.*." This is a missing riscv64 dependency in the conda-forge ecosystem, not a build or code bug in popt itself. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, osx_64, osx_arm64) pass successfully.
